---
title: "5_build_patches_and_connectivity"
output: html_document
params:
  do_mammals: true
  do_birds: true
  species_csv: "Data/Clean/species_table.csv"
  landcover_tif: "Data/Raw/esacci_2022_pfts.tif"
  patch_dir: "Data/Clean/Patches"
  patch_lookup_rds: "Data/Clean/all_patch_lookup.rds"
  connectivity_rds: "Data/Clean/all_connectivity.rds"
  grass_dir: ""
  roi_xmin: 43.18
  roi_xmax: 50.56
  roi_ymin: -25.64
  roi_ymax: -11.89
  overwrite_patch_rasters: true
  stop_on_species_error: false
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Build habitat patches and dispersal-connected population units.
#
# Canonical outputs:
#   - Data/Clean/Patches/<species>.tif
#   - Data/Clean/all_patch_lookup.rds
#   - Data/Clean/all_connectivity.rds

if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
}

source("R/patch_config.R")
load_patch_packages(include_figures = FALSE)
source("R/patch_species_inputs.R")
source("R/patch_habitat.R")
source("R/patch_processing.R")

paths <- patch_paths(params)
run_options <- patch_run_options(params)
roi <- patch_roi(params)

validate_patch_config(
  paths = paths,
  run_options = run_options,
  roi = roi,
  production = TRUE
)
```

```{r prepare_inputs}
selected_species <- read_patch_species_table(
  species_csv = paths$species_csv,
  do_mammals = run_options$do_mammals,
  do_birds = run_options$do_birds
)

message(
  "Validation OK | selected species = ", nrow(selected_species),
  " | mammals = ", sum(selected_species$class_lc == "mammalia"),
  " | birds = ", sum(selected_species$class_lc == "aves")
)
```

```{r habitat_masks}
# ESA CCI land-cover classes are translated into reusable 1/NA habitat masks.
habitat_masks <- load_habitat_masks(paths$landcover_tif, roi)
template <- habitat_masks[[1]]
valid_mask_layers <- names(habitat_masks)

message("Built ", terra::nlyr(habitat_masks), " habitat-mask layers on the analysis grid.")
```

```{r run_pipeline}
patch_pipeline <- run_patch_pipeline(
  selected_species = selected_species,
  paths = paths,
  run_options = run_options,
  habitat_masks = habitat_masks
)

results <- patch_pipeline$results
status_summary <- patch_pipeline$status_summary
all_patch_lookup <- patch_pipeline$all_patch_lookup
all_connectivity <- patch_pipeline$all_connectivity

saveRDS(all_patch_lookup, paths$patch_lookup_rds)
saveRDS(all_connectivity, paths$connectivity_rds)

message("Wrote patch lookup: ", paths$patch_lookup_rds)
message("Wrote connectivity object: ", paths$connectivity_rds)
message("Wrote patch rasters to: ", paths$patch_dir)
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
# Compact knitted summary. This chunk does not write files.
cat("\nPatch and population-unit construction summary\n")
cat("==============================================\n")
cat("Selected species: ", nrow(selected_species), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Retained species with at least one final PU: ", sum(status_summary$status == "retained"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Skipped or errored species: ", sum(status_summary$status != "retained"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Final patches: ", nrow(all_patch_lookup), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Final population units: ", length(all_connectivity), "\n", sep = "")
cat("\nStatus counts:\n")
print(table(status_summary$status, useNA = "ifany"))

```
